title: Rename a bunch of things with "conversation".
description:
A conversation in Wireshark might have two endpoints or might have no
endpoints; few if any have one endpoint.  Distinguish between
conversations and endpoints.

(backported from commit 8195bdd3407d6bdcc0f1afa4245d543dd894cf49)

commits_data.title: Rename a bunch of things with "conversation".
commits_data.message:
Rename a bunch of things with "conversation".

A conversation in Wireshark might have two endpoints or might have no
endpoints; few if any have one endpoint.  Distinguish between
conversations and endpoints.

(backported from commit 8195bdd3407d6bdcc0f1afa4245d543dd894cf49)
